about_the_game:
Play as a lost and confused artificial intelligence searching for its origin. Exploit vulnerabilities across 90+ networks in nanoseconds as you learn about the world in and out of the internet. Learn from each encounter to improve your abilities across a variety of categories.

Key Features

  • Campaign: A campaign of 90+ levels each presenting unique challenges appropriate for that stage of the game.

  • Story: Read through anecdotes of nine different companies as you uncover their secrets.

  • Dynamic Opposition: Security systems operate on a range of behaviors across different maps. Some will attempt to kick you out of the network; others will augment their strength before preventing you from obtaining the goal.

  • Customizable Difficulty: Levels can be repeated with additional modifiers that increase difficulty and multiply score.

  • Upgrade System: Allocate your score among six upgrade categories as you venture into more secure portions of the internet. Increase your power, traversal speed, or remain undetected for longer.

  • No Worries Upgrades: Adjust your upgrade allocations to fit the challenge or your preferred play style. Points are never lost nor locked, so you can try new ideas without missing out.

  • Map Variability: Different types of nodes and connections lead to a diverse range of problems to be overcome.

  • Node Variability: Each node has at least three stats that provide subtle influence to how each level plays out.

  • Variable Game Speed: The game may be high speed, but it will also be your speed. The game can be slowed or paused as desired to let you double-check details.

short_description: You are a lost artificial intelligence adrift on the internet. Infiltrate abstract computer networks filled with defensive complications to expand your world. Improve your capabilities to overcome ever greater challenges. Learn about the state of the world and what you were made for.
